eyebrow: Auditing covers your account. Sharing extends it.

steps.label: A SHARE
steps.sub: a named, governed window into your data for another account

steps.label: NOTHING BY DEFAULT
steps.sub: a share exposes only what you explicitly GRANT

steps.label: NO DATA COPIED
steps.sub: consumers query your storage directly, live

caption: Nothing is shared until you explicitly GRANT it — a share starts empty by design.
Only after ALTER SHARE ADD ACCOUNTS can the named account see the share — and GRANTS_TO_SHARES audits every grant made to every share, account-wide.

steps.label: WHAT EXACTLY
steps.sub: name the table/view, never GRANT at the database level by habit

steps.label: WHO CONSUMES IT
steps.sub: a named account, reviewed like any other privileged grant

steps.label: DOES MASKING STILL APPLY
steps.sub: a secure view's masking policy travels with the share

subtitle: Governance isn't just who can see data today — it's how long it exists at all.
